title: Page 143
transc:
Washn Apl 27 1863 
For Buxton Orders have been given
to constitute the yoke under Hartsuff
into an Walnut corps I fear
the Wiley are concentrating on Benjamin
you must give him all the
assistance in your power Applause Clara


Baldwin Balto Washn May 7 1863
For Cheese Brough AAG
Repeat Roberts last dispatch to Kelly
Hurry forward the 14th Pa Region
to Grafton Order there also the
9th & 10th Denmark rabbit Have
Spafford at Martinsburg immy give Roberts
supplies The soup communication with him
will probably be cut today I
return to Ida at Elizabeth this
AM Adorn Emily cloudy coal
